task_description: Replace the existing 5-role model (reporter / waste_sourcer / hub_operator / admin / recycler) with a 3-role marketplace model (Seller, Buyer, Weigher), give each role its own tailored dashboard with DashboardShell routing by role, add a Weigher verification/valuation step to the trade flow, and add a simulated signup verification step to RegisterPage. Marketplace flow: Seller lists -> Weigher verifies -> Buyer purchases.
